About.subtitle: About Me
About.title: Full Stack Developer
About.p1: I'm <1>Kayo Weiber</1>, an Information Systems student at UEMG and a full-stack developer driven by the passion to turn ideas into meaningful software solutions.
About.p2: My background combines technical support, computer maintenance, and software development, with a focus on building robust, scalable, and useful solutions for everyday workflows.
About.p3: I am currently working as a <1>Development Assistant II</1> at <0>Cervejaria Cidade Imperial</0>, mainly focusing on <2>web development</2>, while continuously improving my skills to face the challenges of the technology market.

list.title: Software Architecture & Modern Systems Design
